title: malva lusitanica subsp. minoricensis
intro: Malva lusitanica subsp. minoricensis, commonly known as Mallow, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include treating digestive issues, skin irritations, and respiratory problems due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Malva lusitanica subsp. minoricensis include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and promoting wound healing, attributed to its therapeutic actions such as demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
